title: Tortang talong
intro: Grilled eggplants peeled, flattened into fans and fried in beaten egg. Smoky and soft inside a golden egg coat, eaten with rice and banana ketchup.

steps.text: Grill the eggplants over charcoal or a gas flame, turning, until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft all the way through.
Let them cool slightly, then peel off the skin, keeping the stem on. Lay each eggplant on a plate and flatten it gently with a fork.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper in a wide, shallow dish.
Heat a tablespoon of oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Dip one eggplant in the egg to coat both sides, lay it in the pan and spoon a little extra egg over it.
Fry until the egg is set and golden underneath, then flip and fry the other side. Repeat with the rest, adding oil as needed.
Serve hot with rice and banana ketchup.

tips: Leaving the stem on gives you a handle for dipping and flipping.
